author: Marlon Chaviano
name: monorepo-go
title: Go monorepo with go.work
description: A Go workspace (go.work): an HTTP API, a worker and a shared package, each in its own module and using only the standard library.

verify.command: for m in apps/api apps/worker packages/shared; do (cd $m && go vet ./... && go build ./... && go test ./...) || exit 1; done

instructions:
## How to work here

- Each app (`apps/api`, `apps/worker`) and package (`packages/shared`) is a Go module; `go.work` ties them together so they can use each other without being published.
- Add a new module with `go work use ./path`. External dependencies go inside the module that uses them (`cd apps/api && go get …`).
- Before finishing, in each module: `go vet ./... && go test ./...`.
- Each app lives in its own folder with its own dependencies; don't mix code from one into another.
- Whatever backend and frontend share (types, API contracts) is defined in one place and documented.
